design_condition: The three building wings are placed along the natural terrain with the hilltop trimmed, creating distinct outdoor spaces and anchoring the school in the landscape.

positive.statement: The project impresses with its natural, child-friendly way of placing a building in a sophisticated environment.
The rooms are logically divided into their different usage units and are easy to find.
Short paths and visual references promote orientation.
The two-storey structure meets noise protection requirements.

negative.statement: The location and design of the open spaces have a schematic effect.
The accessible garden is hardly exposed to sunlight and is not very inviting near the main entrance.
The corridors ultimately leave little visibility.
The architectural expression is too weak in this strong landscape and has a strong barrack character.
The facade design appears fragile and inexperienced, with unfavorable window proportions.
The load transfer is unclear and the bracing is insufficient.
